scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Traditional Artisans (Panchavrutthi Scheme)
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Vishwakarma community.
Applicant or any family member must not have previously availed a loan from KVCDC.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan up to ₹80,000 with a subsidy of up to ₹20,000, totalling assistance of ₹1,00,000 at 4% interest per annum.
